options.command: mkdir -p ~/.docker/buildx && cp .devcontainer/assets/buildkitd.toml ~/.docker/buildx/ && (docker buildx rm concord-builder 2>/dev/null || true) && docker buildx create --name concord-builder --driver docker-container --config .devcontainer/assets/buildkitd.toml --driver-opt network=host && docker buildx use concord-builder && docker buildx inspect --bootstrap && CERT_DIR=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/corekinect && BUILDER=buildx_buildkit_concord-builder0 && if [ -d "$CERT_DIR" ] && docker inspect "$BUILDER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then for cert in "$CERT_DIR"/*.crt; do [ -f "$cert" ] && docker cp "$cert" "$BUILDER:/tmp/$(basename $cert)" && docker exec "$BUILDER" sh -c "cat /tmp/$(basename $cert) >> /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && rm /tmp/$(basename $cert)"; done; echo 'CA certs injected into buildkit'; fi
